_readme: Claims ledger for the on-page legend. Every on-page claim has exactly one tag. Tags: shipped | specified | assumption | limit | human_gate. evidence_level: public (a public URL a visitor can open) | self_reported.

tags.shipped: Built and demonstrably in use or published. Needs a public link, or is marked self_reported.
tags.specified: Designed and written down, not (yet) implemented. The CV itself makes this distinction.
tags.assumption: Something the design relies on that has not been verified. Concepts that illustrate an idea sit here.
tags.limit: An evidence limitation: what cannot be shown or is not claimed.
tags.human_gate: A decision a person must make before anything proceeds (approval, release gate).

claims.text: A missed-call text-back service. Live, launched 19 October 2026.
Built on Cloudflare Workers, D1, Twilio Voice and SMS, Stripe Checkout and Billing, and Resend.
Customers keep their existing business number.
Release controls: signed webhooks, duplicate-send prevention, opt-outs, usage caps and automated tests.
For UK small businesses.
A football opportunity map of England for parents, guardians and coaches, in controlled beta.
Uses age, postcode, transport mode and travel time to assess proximity and practical access.
Architecture designed around Next.js, TypeScript, MapLibre, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, GeoPandas and routing services.
Controlled beta access and safeguards against bulk extraction were defined.
National scores and heatmaps are specified for PitchReach. They are not on the public site yet.
Journey planning by car and bus is open to everyone.
No established customer adoption is claimed.
A free calendar of upcoming UK Part-66 exam sittings, for people studying for the aircraft maintenance licence. Dates come from the UK CAA and Part-147 centres, and no account is needed.
Every date on the live calendar links to its source.
No sittings count is shown.
The Drew & Crew Ltd company site, live, listing 9 ventures.
A published, evidence-led global investing guide, being expanded.
Includes a tax-residency ranking of 25 countries.
5 of the 25 countries are pending sources.
Not financial advice. Sources, assumptions and limitations are stated.
Nothing is published, sent or paid for without approval, and every claim must be backed by evidence.
Logging and observability record what ran, what changed and what was approved.
A concept, not a deployed system.
Signup, payment, number provisioning and setup messages run automatically, with no manual step between a paid signup and a working service.
One text per caller per 24 hours, UK mobile numbers only, and the owner's own calls are skipped.
Written in JavaScript on the Cloudflare Workers runtime, with SQL in D1 for data, and HTML, CSS and browser JavaScript for the pages.
Each service is called through its API: Twilio for voice and SMS, Stripe for checkout and billing, Resend for email, D1 for storage.
Every release needs approval. Builds are staged, tested, backed up and given a rollback point first.
New features ship switched off. They are switched on in a separate, approved change, and a kill switch turns each one off again.
When automatic setup fails or a trial is refused, the owner is alerted so a person decides what happens next.
Built as AI-assisted automation: AI workers implement each staged release and call tools through APIs and connectors. Reviewed the evidence and approved.
A focus tool that helps students actually put in the study hours they plan (concept).
